definitions.rate: Real next-layer per-SSD bytes / current-layer original compute budget; at handoff, next request L0 replaces current request nominal bytes
definitions.compute_budget_only: Rate active on [current compute start,current compute end)
definitions.through_exposed_wait: Rate active until next layer begins computing, including exposed wait; next request admission may be later than prefetch completion
definitions.exclusions: No prior compute budget exists for each NPU initial L0; final request last layer has no successor. Fixed warm start avoids initial stage.
definitions.status: Additional descriptive proxy; not actual SSD throughput, a service schedule, all-deadline feasibility proof, or replacement for agreed current-request D/C acceptance.
